correctness.rationale: Verified each implication of the three-white witness-center criterion; absence of first force for at least four whites follows from degree<=2 of the original graph. Every pair of whites extends to a witness triple, guaranteeing monotonic forcing for smaller white sets. Pairwise inclusion-exclusion for path witness centers is exact; for cycles the sole triple intersection arises from the two alternating triples on six vertices. Independent literal forcing verifies coefficients and minimality on 16 graph profiles.

value.rationale: A natural exact enumerative refinement of the established minimum-zero-forcing problem for complements of canonical sparse graph families, together with all-minimal-set classification. The exceptional n=6 cycle inclusion-exclusion correction and the extension of every two-white set to a successful triple explain structural behavior not available from scalar minima or generic top coefficients.
